dedupe_keys.name: validated series and design labels with material intensities for soviet era mass housing in estonia

description: Elisa Iliste and Ingrid Viskus deposited building-stock classification data and material-intensity coefficients in the TalTech Data Repository. The classification table covers 1,868 Estonian apartment buildings with expert-validated building-series and standard-design labels. Building-register identifiers link labels to staircase and floor counts, construction year, wall type, apartment counts, floor and façade areas, and footprint geometry. Additional CSV tables give material intensities by design, archetype and whole stock, with panel counts for the 111-121 series. Materials include concrete, lightweight concrete, cement, steel, timber and brick. Quantities use units specified in column headers, including cubic metres, kilograms or pieces per square metre. The data support representation of existing buildings and their material requirements in building-stock studies. Public files are available under CC BY 4.0 at no stated charge. Caveats: register attributes and quantities transcribed from archival design documents have different origins; the date of the register extract is not stated. No observation timestep or directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
